events.title: Roving Rhythm Crew by Junkyard Beats
events.location: State Library of Queensland, Stanley Place, South Bank
events.description: Join the Roving Rhythm Crew in The Corner these school holidays for high energy rhythm and fun. Performed by Junkyard Beats and presented by QPAC, this crew of mischief makers weave between audiences using recycled instruments, body percussion, physical theatre, and cheeky improvisation to turn any space into a stage.See more of Junkyard Beats in their award-winning performance The Box Show, showing at QPAC from 30 Sep to 3 Oct 2026. This project has been assisted by the Australian Government through Creative Australia, its principal arts investment and advisory body.

events.title: Podcasting 101
events.location: State Library of Queensland, Stanley Place, South Bank
events.description: Interested in creating your own podcast? Want to learn how to produce one using free software? Then podcasting 101 is perfect for you! During the workshop you will: Get expert advice on how to get a great recording (including using the resources available at State Library). Learn the basics of how to record and edit audio in Audacity. Pick up tips and tricks when it comes to hosting, distributing and building an audience for your content. Our 101 workshops are a great way to gain some new skills and explore creative tools learning from experienced local creatives in an inclusive space.Please consult our conditions of entry and Ticketing Terms and Conditions.Participants under 16 years of age must be accompanied by a guardian.Please contact us if you need support to participate in this event.
